document_type: English scientific summary derived from an existing frozen protocol
study: Conditional bidirectional screen of 19 continuous measurements
trigger: For each fault, 2*C_AN < C_AA + C_NN using integer clean 8-hour counts at rank 95 over all 4320 cells

directions.S1: Replace one post-update measurement in AN with the paired controller-input value
directions.S2: Replace one controller-input measurement in AA with the paired post-update value

source_column_indexing: C00 denotes XMEAS(1); C01 denotes XMEAS(2)
data_roles: The same column operation is applied to normal and fault training, normal calibration, and normal and fault evaluation data
refit_scope: Complete workflow within each variant and replicate
analysis_status: Post hoc conditional screen; all prespecified measurements and both directions retained
intervals: Pointwise descriptive crossed-bootstrap intervals without multiplicity adjustment
